scope: Read-only report coordinator, real owned pod-initiated OVSDB source, Early Report Ack/retry and Topology Query dispatch; no discovery/WSC admission
source_tests: Atomic generation/revision publication and bounded lease
Changed facts without revision and changed identity/input context withdraw source
Early Report new-MID retry, bounded attempts and delayed/live-attempt Ack correlation
No unnecessary retry on Ack arrival; fixed deadline despite source renewal
Peer/ingress/generation rejection before reassembly; duplicate/query-rate/event budgets
Partial send stops on source change; expired/failed sends cannot become success
Config-only change keeps observed SSID; separate manager State changes response
Unknown client age, incompatible security and missing channel withdraw reports
Database disconnection withdrawal and fresh-generation reconnect
independent_references: tshark 3.6.2 and 4.2.2 inspect both final receive traces

retained_development_findings.finding: An empty monitored client table may be omitted from the initial OVSDB map
retained_development_findings.resolution: Require complete schema/monitor selection, then interpret an omitted empty table correctly; missing client inventory is not silently defaulted

retained_development_findings.finding: A valid optional channel field can be cleared
retained_development_findings.resolution: Unknown channel withdraws the source instead of causing a comparison error; real-database regression added

retained_development_findings.finding: The initial negative Ethernet observation was shorter than the topology response window
retained_development_findings.resolution: Final two runs observe at least 1.1 seconds with the coordinator still running before fixture cleanup

remaining: Qualified actual pod facts and trusted link/controller identity
Native peer profile/security/media reconciliation and full AP Capability requirements
Discovery/report integration into application lifecycle and native controller inventory
Durable authenticated WSC-to-operation admission and controller-caused OVSDB/hwsim/client experiment
Read-only actual-pod qualification followed by unchanged physical-pod proof
